Minecraft Treasure Hunt watch challenge offers two companion rewards

Eligible TikTok and Twitch viewing can unlock the Aqua Cool Fish and Amethyst Drone through September 13, with redemption due by the same deadline.

By PlayScout EditorialSeptember 4, 2026Source checked · Minecraft.net · Mojang
Player impact

Eligible TikTok and Twitch viewing can unlock the Aqua Cool Fish and Amethyst Drone through September 13, with redemption due by the same deadline.

PRIMARY SOURCEMinecraft.net · MojangOpen the original announcement ↗

Explore, craft and build alone or with friends in the definitive block-based sandbox. This briefing keeps the player-facing consequence close to the source and links to the original announcement for complete details.

What was announced

Mojang’s Treasure Hunt watch challenge runs from September 4 through September 13, 2026. Eligible TikTok live streams require three minutes of viewing; eligible Twitch Partner or Affiliate streams in the Minecraft category require five minutes.

What it means for players

The TikTok path awards the Aqua Cool Fish, while Twitch awards the Amethyst Drone. The offer requires Minecraft: Bedrock Edition and is limited to one of each reward per Microsoft account.

What to check next

Confirm that the stream displays the Game Reward treatment, that the correct Microsoft account is linked and that the platform delivers the code. Redeem through Minecraft.net before the stated September 13 deadline.
